notes.title: We will no longer be able to support Psycho.
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we regret to inform you that we will no longer be able to support the game. This means that we will not be providing any updates or bug fixes as we are no longer able to make any changes to the game. We initially created this game as a hobby project when we were still high school students back in 2020. However, we have unfortunately lost all the latest project files, and the game mechanics are now quite messy and difficult to understand. As a result, we have made the difficult decision to discontinue support for the game.

Although you can still play the game in both single-player and multiplayer modes, some features may not work correctly, and players may not be able to complete the game. Despite this, we hope that you will still enjoy playing the game and have a great experience with it. We will be reducing the price of the game soon. Thank you for your support of our hobby project, and we apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Thank you for supporting us. We promise to continue improving and create an even better game in the future. This has been the biggest lesson of our lives.

notes.title: Psycho is now launched!
notes.content:
Psycho is now launched on Steam!

[previewyoutube=MHz235ujGpg;full][/previewyoutube]

”Psycho” is a 3D horror game that allows you to explore and survive with your friends in the terrible mystery bunker.

Background Story
A young man named Eric mysteriously disappeared in the restricted area in the west of the country. It's well-known that this place is cursed. Anyone who enters will never come back. The police immediately entered the area to find the missing man. Few people dare to enter this place. They all afraid of the dark cemetery atmosphere, it feels like someone is staring at all times. But the world always has heroes. Police Officer Josh and his team are the only ones who dare to enter this place to search for the missing man.

You will be playing the role of a team of police officer Josh. As soon as you step into the restricted area, the dark will surround you. The light fades away, leaving only darkness and you. You only have a flashlight and your feet to escape, survive, and do the mission in this place. No one can help you. It all depends on you. Eric's life is in your hand. You have to quickly find Eric before it's too late.

Game Objective
Notes on the map will tell what you need to do and tell you the whole story. I suggest you read them all to understand the story and what you need to do next.
